Package game.plants

Interface Regressible

All Known Implementing Classes:
Cauliflower, CauliflowerSprout, Crop, Melon, MelonSprout, Parsnip, Plant, Strawberry, StrawberrySeedling, StrawberrySprout, Tomato
public interface Regressible
Capability interface for Ground that can be pushed back one growth stage, e.g. by a pest. Callers find it through location.getGroundAs(Regressible.class), so they never need to know which plant, or which stage of it, is on the tile. Implementing classes decide what the earlier stage is, including dying back to bare ground when there is no earlier stage.
